rationale: The papers 'Full-Disk Spectroscopy of the Solar Corona Across a Solar Cycle with Hinode/EIS' (2606.04979) and 'Solar-Cycle Modulation and Photospheric Magnetic Control of Turbulence in the Young Solar Wind' (2608.11438) provide insights into solar activity and its variations, contributing evidence that partially addresses the understanding of the solar activity cycle.
